reason: St. Anne's-Belfield is firmographically on-niche (independent PreK-12 day/boarding school, 900+ students, 134 staff, ~$25.8M revenue, Charlottesville VA) but fails on situation and on the quotable-line rule: its entire live Greenhouse feed is teachers, substitutes, coaches, a Controller and a Chief Advancement Officer, with zero technology, cybersecurity, vendor-governance or AI-policy postings, and the one matched job (Chief Advancement Officer, score 0.40) is a pure fundraising role whose full JD contains no technology language at all -- the match came from independent-school boilerplate, not from pain. It is also affirmatively disqualified: the school has had an in-house Director of Information Technology (Mark Adair) since Dec 2019, promoted from Co-Director of Technology in 2014 and credentialed through ATLIS (Technology Leaders in Independent Schools, ALI Cohort 2021-22), so the 'outgrew reactive outsourced IT with no technology leadership' situation Kenneth Thomas sells into is not present here and is not observable in any public artifact.
